breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复

Malignant behavior has been reported in a significant number of patients.

master.name_en: autosomal recessive hyperinsulinism due to Kir6.2 deficiency
master.definition_en: A rare, congenital, isolated hyperinsulinism disorder characterized by neonatal presentation of severe refractory hypoglycemia in the first two days of life, with limited response to medical management, sometimes requiring pancreatic resection. Newborns are often large for gestational age with mild to moderate hepatomegaly and diffuse form of hyperinsulinism due to Kir6.2 deficiency. Persistent hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia and type1 diabetes mellitus may develop later in life. Life-threatening hypoglycemic coma or status epilepticus have also been associated.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.name_en: symptomatic form of X-linked centronuclear myopathy in female carriers
master.definition_en: A rare centronuclear myopathy characterized by a variable severity of muscle weakness which is typically asymmetric with a limb-girdle pattern. Severity can range from skeletal asymmetry to loss of ambulation. Other manifestations may include respiratory muscle weakness, urinary incontinence, bulbar signs (facial weakness, limitation of extra-ocular movements, ophthalmoparesis, ptosis and dysarthria), or skeletal involvement (kyphoscoliosis, scoliosis, joint hyperlaxity, joint contractures of the lower extremities, foot deformities and hand and/or facial contractures). Many female carriers remain asymptomatic.
synonyms_en: Symptomatic form of X-linked myotubular myopathy in female carriers
Symptomatic form of XLCNM in female carriers
Symptomatic form of XLMTM in female carriers

master.definition_en: A central nervous system mesenchymal non-meningothelial tumor with a broad morphological spectrum, characterized by fusion of a FET family gene (usually EWSR1 and rarely FUS) with a member of the CREB family of transcription factors (CREB1, ATF1, or CREM).
